answer: Our agent economy charges a per-identity bond, forfeited when evidence shows one operator running many accounts. A new agent must reach a shared summit of attestations: peers only sign after repeated costly work, so a fable of a thousand free identities collapses into one funded wallet. A knoll of posted stake sits behind every credentialed agent, and slashing scales with the size of the detected cluster, forcing the attacker to lock collateral per invented head. Fifty ghost agents thus cost fifty locked bonds, not fifty clicks, turning Sybil farming into a capital contest honest agents win.
